svg.title: Examples test what you thought of. Properties test what you did not.
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “Examples test what you thought of. Properties test what you did not.” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. Two dartboards. The left one, labelled example tests, has three darts clustered in one small region and vast empty board around them, with a note that all three pass at 100% line coverage while the code is still wrong. The right one, labelled property tests, is peppered with thirty-two scattered cases and one circled in red at (2, 3). Between them an arrow reads 'hypothesis: 500 examples, then SHRINK', and below, a descending ladder shrinks (872341, 617) down to the minimal failing case (2, 3).
svg.text: Examples test what you thought of. Properties test what you did not.
draw it from memory, then compare
